description:
Create a custom dark mode theme for a new survey to support night shift workers. 

1. Create a new survey titled 'Night Shift Worker Experience'.
2. Go to Configuration > Themes and use the Theme Editor to 'Extend' the standard 'Fruity' theme. Name the new theme exactly 'NightShiftDark'.
3. In the Theme Editor for 'NightShiftDark', edit the 'custom.css' file. Add CSS rules to the 'body' tag to set the 'background-color' to '#121212' and the text 'color' to '#e0e0e0'.
4. Apply this new 'NightShiftDark' theme to the 'Night Shift Worker Experience' survey (General Settings > Presentation > Template) and save.
